17 DESIGN PERFORMANCE SAFETY TECHNOLOGY COMFORT & CONVENIENCE SPECIFICATIONS
Standard All-Wheel Drive (AWD) will give you the confidence to stay
the course through your journey’s twists and turns. It provides
excellent traction and responsive performance on slippery surfaces
and during aggressive starts. FIAT® 500X AWD also works with the
Electronic Stability Control (ESC)3 system to improve dynamic handling.
Getting optimum AWD performance requires no driver input when in
Auto Mode — FIAT 500X knows when to fully engage on its own. The
secret is a disconnecting rear axle that automatically selects Front-
Wheel Drive (FWD) or AWD based on various inputs. All actions are
intelligently and seamlessly engaged based on conditions and driving
style, and have the added benefit of maximizing fuel efficiency.

18 DESIGN PERFORMANCE SAFETY TECHNOLOGY COMFORT & CONVENIENCE SPECIFICATIONS
D R I V I N G À L A M O D E
The FIAT® Dynamic Selector Traction Control System puts
three customized driving modes at your fingertips:
AUTO MODE is designed for the everyday, routine stuff —
it will smooth things out to help optimize fuel efficiency,
emissions and comfort.
SPORT MODE is for those who’d prefer spirited performance
with a little more road feel. With it, the Electronic Stability
Control (ESC)3 and steering calibrations are tuned for
a sportier feel and quicker driving response. Additionally,
Sport Mode optimizes the transmission shift points for
maximized performance and accelerator feedback.
TRACTION+ MODE maximizes low-speed traction — the
kind you need when things get a little slick or bumpy. It all
works by providing additional wheel-slip through specially
tuned chassis controls and a more direct engine response.
